results.title: 'I Didn't See the Rules': Ukrainian Fitness Influencer Apologises After Riding Egg-Laying Turtle in Oman
results.description: Ukrainian fitness influencer Vadym Oleynik apologises after footage appeared to show him sitting on a sea turtle at a protected nesting site in Oman.

results.title: Siemens Healthineers launches INNOVANCE D-Dimer 2.0 globally to support VTE assessment
results.description: D-dimer testing measures fragments produced when blood clots break down and can help assess patients with increased clotting activity.
